fichas.title: Cold façades
fichas.summary: A cold façade is a single-skin curtain wall with a ventilated cavity behind it and single- or double-glazed external cladding panels. The panels may be fixed around the perimeter, on two sides, or at points. Point-fixed panels require technical or special-case approval. The façade panels may be colour-coated or screen-printed; visible edges are finely ground and polished, while non-visible edges are ground.
furniture_equipment: Single- or double-glazed external cladding panels

dimensions.label: Ventilated cavity width
dimensions.context: Approximate width of the cavity behind the single-skin curtain wall.

figure_refs: 1 Cold façade with rear ventilation and glass parapet cladding (EnEV → refs)

fichas.title: Warm façade without ventilation at rear
fichas.summary: A warm façade may use post-and-rail curtain walling or storey-height curtain wall elements. Its non-transparent parts or parapets have glass panels. The external panel may be backed by thermal insulation, with an internal layer sealed against water-vapour diffusion. An additional glass layer may create a two-dimensional appearance; if the panel remains the drainage layer, the construction is still a warm façade.

fichas.title: Flush glass curtain wall
fichas.summary: Structural glazing creates a uniform, flat façade appearance. A full-surface glass appearance is possible when panes are glued to metal frames. The system and structural sealing require applicable technical approval. In Germany, façades over the stated height require additional mechanical fixing of panes, and insulated glazing requires a UV-resistant edge seal.

dimensions.label: Façade height threshold for additional mechanical pane fixing
dimensions.context: In Germany, façades over this height must have additional mechanical fixing of the panes.
dimensions.ocr_raw: all façades over 8 m in height must have an additional mechanical fixing of the panes

fichas.title: Radar damping
fichas.summary: Radar reflection damping may be required by German Air Traffic Control for façades of larger buildings near airports. Special coatings can damp radar signals through absorption and phase-delayed interference. Glass structure and light and energy performance are determined for each application, and a radar report is generally commissioned for each building. Other façade surfaces are also investigated.

fichas.title: Curtain walling with fire-resistant glass
fichas.summary: Fire-resistant glazing has limited practicality for external use because its foaming fire-protection layer must not be heated beyond the stated temperature range. For façades exposed to direct sunshine, this can only be guaranteed with effective sun shading.

dimensions.label: Maximum temperature range for foaming fire-protection layer
dimensions.context: The foaming fire-protection layer cannot be heated over this temperature range.

fichas.title: Sun screens
fichas.summary: Sun screens are additional external transparent sun-shading layers made from metallic oxide-coated toughened glass panes. The coating should face the weather side. Panels may be fixed around the perimeter, on two sides, or at points; point fixing requires technical or special-case approval.
